sources.junctions: POST https://openmapx.com/api/integrations/routing/navigation/junctions using junctionLookupPoints for the live route

transformations: Route cropped to original steps 12 and 13, retaining their distances, maneuvers, signs and geometry; step indices now start at 0.
OSM ways retain only IDs, versions, timestamps and tags. No user metadata or imagery included.
Topology retains way node IDs, coordinates and tags; user metadata omitted.
Outgoing ways mapped from captured shared-node topology by mapJunctionWays; lane assignments are not inferred.
manifest.note: OSRM reports slight left while OSM approach arrows say slight_right. Neither identifies the A46 lane assignment consistently.
